Ivy: Heads-up-- OrchID sent acceptance criteria: mixed workload (gen 70% / embed 30%), target sustained 150 rps, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms. Also asked for a 50M tokens/mo cost ballpark and confirmation of CMK support. Can we run dedicated?

Raj: We can. Recommend ramp 40 -> 90 -> 150 (10m each) with a 20m soak. Prewarm KV with ~3k short prefixes. Will capture p50/p95/p99, token counts, and infra metrics.

Tess: KMS note: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys; Private supports HSM-backed keys. I'll attach the compliance one-pager.

Raj: Repro snippet (simple):
```
# warmup
for i in {1..3000}; do curl -s -X POST https://redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"lite-13b","input":"hi","max_tokens":8}' >/dev/null; done
# ramp using run_rate.sh
./run_rate.sh --rate 40 --dur 10m; ./run_rate.sh --rate 90 --dur 10m; ./run_rate.sh --rate 150 --dur 10m; ./run_rate.sh --rate 150 --dur 20m # soak
```
I'll collect logs: run_40.log, run_90.log, run_150.log, prometheus snapshot, and GPU telemetry.

ops-bot: Allocation made: dedicated-small (2x GPU) 2026-04-10T16:00Z id alloc-b72c.

Ivy: Pricing ask: roughs from product: hosted ~$0.00075/token (~$37.5k for 50M), dedicated 2-GPU amortized ~$20k-24k/month depending on util/quant. Raj please add scenarios (util % and fp16 vs int8).

Raj: Will include three scenarios and note that embeddings drive token counts lower per request. Abort criteria: p99>900ms OR error rate>1.5% OR GPU mem>90%. I'll post artifacts and 1-paragraph exec summary after the run.

Tess: I'll upload the SOC2/ISO one-pager into the customer packet afterwards.

Ivy: Great. Demo Friday pending green. Ping on start. :thumbsup:
